info.title: Talent Radar API
info.description: REST API for the Talent Radar sports talent management platform.

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Teams registered under an age group

tags.name: ObserverEvaluations
tags.description: Monthly admin evaluations of observers/scouts (draft → publish → archive)

tags.name: CoachEvaluations
tags.description: Monthly admin evaluations of coaches/scouts (draft → publish → archive)

vaultToken.name: X-Vault-Token
vaultToken.description: 15-minute token obtained via POST /auth/vaultPassword/verify — required to read ID-card vault endpoints (C3)

teamName.description: Free-text team name, used when the team isn't in the registered teams list (mutually exclusive with team)

createdBy.description: specs/010-professional-lens-creator — the user who created this player. Populated to { _id, name } only for GET /players requests made by an admin; absent for every other role and for GET /players/:id.

matchDate.description: Set server-side to the report creation date

status.description: Videos transcode on Bunny; images are ready immediately

url.description: Signed, short-lived delivery URL generated on read (HLS for video, token URL for images); null while a video is processing/failed

embedUrl.description: Bunny token-embed iframe URL (video, when ready)

download.description: Backend download endpoint for the 720p MP4 (video, when ready)

seasonMatch.description: Set on videos only, auto-resolved server-side from the player's team fixtures — never client-supplied

linkedVideo.description: Set on companion images only — the PlayerMedia id of the video this image was uploaded alongside

ageGroup.description: AgeGroup id (populated on read); absent for league: 'professional' fixtures (Stage 13)

league.description: Premier or Professionals league — separate schedule per age group

attendees.description: Scouts who self-enrolled via the attend endpoint (not settable on create/update)

get.summary: List all active coaches (admin only)

post.summary: Create a new coach account (admin only)

get.summary: List deactivated (soft-deleted) users (admin only)
Get a specific user by ID (admin only)

patch.summary: Update a user's name or phone (admin only)
Restore a deactivated user (admin only)
Change a user's password (admin only)

delete.summary: Permanently delete a (previously deactivated) user (admin only)

patch.summary: Upload/replace a user's profile image (admin only)
Upload/replace the front side of a user's national ID card (admin only)

200.description: Front ID-card image uploaded (no URL/path is ever returned — C3)

patch.summary: Upload/replace the back side of a user's national ID card (admin only)

200.description: Back ID-card image uploaded (no URL/path is ever returned — C3)

get.summary: Report which ID-card sides exist (admin + vault token — never returns a URL or path, C3)

200.description: Presence flags for each ID-card side

get.summary: Stream a national ID-card side's raw bytes through the backend (admin + vault token — vault Storage zone has no CDN, no URL is ever exposed, C3)

200.description: Raw image bytes (Cache-Control - no-store, access is audit-logged)

get.summary: List teams (optionally scoped to an age group via the nested /ages/{id}/teams mount)

parameters.name: ageGroup
parameters.description: Filter by age group id (implicit when called via /ages/{id}/teams)

get.summary: Get a specific team by id

patch.summary: Update a team (admin only)

get.summary: List season matches (filter by ageGroup, season, status)
Get a season match with linked reports

patch.summary: Update a season match (admin only)
Update a match's status/result (the assigned attendee coach/observer/proScout, or an admin)

post.summary: Scout self-enrolls to attend this match (coach/observer/proScout)

403.description: Match is outside the caller's scope (proScout)

delete.summary: Scout removes self from this match's attendees (coach/observer/proScout)

get.summary: List all scouting reports for a player

post.summary: Create a scouting report for a player (coach, observer, or proScout — each within its own data scope)

201.description: Report created — overallRating auto-calculated as average of 12 metrics

get.summary: Get aggregated statistics across all reports for a player
Get a specific scouting report

patch.summary: Update a scouting report (coach, observer, or proScout — own reports only)

delete.summary: Delete a scouting report (admin only — no other role, including proScout, may delete)

get.summary: List players (coaches see only their own; observers see assigned; proScout sees the professional league plus its own team-less players; admins see all)

parameters.name: isProfessional
parameters.description: Admin-facing lens for professional-league players (Stage 4c). Available to every role but narrows only within that role's existing scope — it grants no new access.

post.summary: Create a player (coach, observer, proScout, or admin — admin may assign the player to a coach/observers/proScout in the same request)

coach.description: Admin only. Id of an existing active user whose role is `coach`.

observers.description: Admin only. Ids of existing active users whose role is `observer`.

proScout.description: Admin only. Id of an existing active user whose role is `proScout` — sets `createdBy` to this id, the axis proScout scope is keyed on.

get.summary: Get a specific player by ID

patch.summary: Update a player's details (coach, observer, proScout, or admin — each within its own data scope; ownership fields stay locked here for every role, admin included, see /players/{id}/coach, /observers and /proScout)
Update a player's recruitment status (admin only)
Assign or re-assign the coach who owns a player (admin only)
patch.description: The only way to give a player an owner. Needed above all for players whose coach account was permanently deleted — those keep their data but lose the `coach` field, and stay visible to admins (and any assigned observers) until they are handed to a new coach here.

coach.description: Id of an existing active user whose role is `coach`

patch.summary: Assign (or re-assign) the proScout a player is scoped to (admin only)
patch.description: Sets `createdBy` to the given proScout's id — the axis proScout read/write scope is keyed on (services/scope.js playerScopeFor). Mirrors PATCH /players/{id}/coach for the proScout ownership axis.

proScout.description: Id of an existing active user whose role is `proScout`

get.summary: Player counts grouped by age group (coach sees own; admin sees all, or a specific coach/observer via query)

parameters.name: coach
parameters.description: Admin only — count a specific coach's players

parameters.name: observer
parameters.description: Admin only — count a specific observer's players

200.description: Counts grouped by age group id

professional.description: Stage 4c — count of isProfessional:true players within the caller's scope, honouring the same status/coach/observer conditions as `counts`. Derived from the flag, never from total minus the sum of counts.

get.summary: Average overall rating across scouting reports for a set of players

200.description: Map of player id to average rating

patch.summary: Add/remove assigned observers for a player without touching status (admin only)
Upload/replace a player's profile image (coach, admin, or proScout — each within its own data scope)

get.summary: List all media files for a player

post.summary: Upload a companion IMAGE for a video (coach/observer, multipart). Standalone image upload is not supported — every image must accompany a video via linkedVideo. Video uploads go directly to Bunny via POST /media/video.

linkedVideo.description: Required PlayerMedia id of the video (same player, same uploader) this photo accompanies — max 2 images per video

201.description: Image uploaded and stored in Bunny Storage

post.summary: Start a video upload — mints a Bunny Stream video and returns a presigned TUS envelope. seasonMatch is no longer accepted from the client — it is auto-resolved from the player's team fixtures (a 3-day window around the match) and the caller's role.

title.description: Required when no match auto-links (freeform mode)

description.description: Required when no match auto-links (freeform mode)

fileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the video file, computed client-side before upload — used to block duplicate uploads of the same video for this player

201.description: Video created (processing) with a TUS upload envelope

400.description: Missing title/description in freeform mode (no match qualified to auto-link), missing/invalid fileHash, or this video (by hash) was already uploaded for this player

post.summary: Re-issue a TUS upload envelope for a still-processing video (resume after an interrupted upload) — coach/observer, uploader only

200.description: New TUS upload envelope for the same Bunny Stream video

400.description: The video is not awaiting upload (already ready/failed, or not a video)

get.summary: Preview the video-upload gate for this player without creating anything — lets the UI show whether upload is freeform (title/description required) or will auto-link to a match.

200.description: Current gate mode (same for any role — coach and observer are treated identically)

seasonMatch.description: Present only when mode is "gated" — the match this upload will auto-link to

get.summary: Get a specific media file

delete.summary: Delete a media file (also removes the bytes from Bunny Stream/Storage) — admin-only

patch.summary: Approve or reject a video linked to a season match (admin only) — controls whether the uploader counts as having attended that match

get.summary: Download the 720p MP4 for a video (admin only)
List observer evaluations (observer sees own published; admin sees all, filterable)

post.summary: Create an observer evaluation (draft) — admin only; stats auto-captured

get.summary: Published trend + category averages + latest for an observer

patch.summary: Publish an evaluation — notifies the observer (admin owner only)
Archive an evaluation — hides it from the observer (admin owner only)
Re-capture the auto stats for a draft (admin owner only)

get.summary: Get a specific evaluation

patch.summary: Update evaluation content (admin owner only)

get.summary: Get the logged-in coach's dashboard statistics
Get the global admin dashboard statistics
Get total/selected player counts for every coach in one call (admin only)

200.description: Map of coach id to stats

get.summary: Get dashboard statistics for a specific coach (admin only)
Get the logged-in observer's dashboard statistics
Get dashboard statistics for a specific observer (admin only)
Get the logged-in proScout's dashboard statistics (professional-league scope only)
List coach evaluations (coach sees own published; admin sees all, filterable)

post.summary: Create a coach evaluation (draft) — admin only; stats auto-captured

get.summary: Published trend + category averages + latest for a coach
Combined "overall" card for a coach/month across all admins — average + drill-down list. Locked until the requesting admin has published their own evaluation for the same coach/month.

patch.summary: Publish an evaluation — notifies the coach (admin owner only)
Archive an evaluation — hides it from the coach (admin owner only)
Re-capture the auto stats for a draft (admin owner only)

get.summary: Get a specific evaluation

patch.summary: Update evaluation content (admin owner only)

post.summary: Logout and clear refresh token cookie
Obtain a new access token using the refresh token cookie
Send a password reset code to the user's email
Verify the 6-digit reset code from email

put.summary: Reset password after successful code verification

200.description: Password reset — new access token returned

patch.summary: Change current user's password (requires old password)

200.description: Password changed — new access token returned

patch.summary: Update current user's profile (name, phone)

post.summary: Re-verify the admin's own login password to obtain a short-lived vault token (admin only)
post.description: The vault token (15 minutes) is required as the X-Vault-Token header on ID-card endpoints (C3). Repeated wrong passwords lock the vault temporarily via vaultFailedAttempts/vaultLockedUntil on the user document.

423.description: Too many failed attempts — temporarily locked

post.summary: One-time bootstrap — promote an existing account to admin (no auth required, gated by a setup key)
post.description: Refuses if any admin account already exists (active or deactivated) or if the setup key doesn't match ADMIN_SETUP_KEY. Intended for initial deployment only — the normal path is the seedAdmin() bootstrap in server.js using ADMIN_* env vars.

email.description: Email of an existing account to promote

403.description: Invalid setup key, or an admin already exists

get.summary: List all age groups (admin, coach, or observer)
Get a specific age group by ID (admin, coach, or observer)
